topic: How to Open a Brokerage Account
source_evidence: Account maintenance fees vary among broker-dealers and they do not necessarily apply to all brokerage accounts at a broker-dealer. Wire or Transfer Fees - fees a broker-dealer may charge you to wire money from your brokerage account or to transfer assets or cash to another broker-dealer.
question: What should you check about account maintenance and transfer fees before opening a brokerage account?
answer: Check which fees apply to your account. A broker may charge a maintenance fee for certain accounts, and fees may vary between firms; a broker may also charge to wire money or transfer cash or assets to another broker. Ask the firm about its fees before opening the account.
